paragraphs: Browser-based configuration and monitoring tool for the LipSync assistive joystick mouse. Connect the LipSync over USB serial (Web Serial or a WebUSB fallback on Android), adjust sip/puff thresholds, deadzones, cursor speed and acceleration, feedback, and Bluetooth settings, guard against accidental input with the restriction toggles (firmware 4.4.0+), remap the external assistive-switch jacks (firmware 4.5.0+), run device self-tests and a health diagnostic, calibrate the joystick — and check for and install firmware updates — all from a secure Chromium page with no install.
Part of the OpenAT Joystick Project by Makers Making Change, a program of Neil Squire.
